thread:
maria: Heads up — we need a quick experiment before the webinar next Tue. Can we A/B test an inline FAQ + a compact pricing calculator (two placements) and route leads differently based on selection? :rocket:
jon: Yup. What are the two placements? above-the-fold vs inside the pricing accordion?
kevin: Above-the-fold (compact calc) and a second variant with calc inside the FAQ beneath tier table. Visuals are small — I can mock in Figma today.
emma: Copy note: for the calc variant, change the CTA to 'Estimate monthly cost' and add microcopy: "Results are estimated; contact sales for SLA pricing."
sarah: For routing: if user interacts with calc and selects >50k tokens or opts for "Dedicated", tag lead as "high-touch" and send to sales-ops queue. Otherwise route to marketing nurtures. I can wire the tag in inbound API.
maria: Nice. Metrics we care about: calc engagement %, demo signups, net new MQLs, and webinar RSVP uplift. Also need to validate EU vs US responses — run geo split.
jon: Proposed experiment matrix: 50/50 calc placement; within each, 20% show updated tier names (names test), 80% control. That gives quick signal on placement effect and naming interaction.
kevin: Tier-name suggestions to test (short): Variant A = "Launch / Scale / Enterprise"; Variant B = "Starter / Growth / Enterprise". I'll add both to the mock.
emma: Tone for Variant A is more startup-forward, Variant B conservative. We'll swap microcopy accordingly.
sarah: On instrumentation: make sure events: calc_open, calc_submit, calc_value_selected, faq_open, tier_name_click, route_assigned. I added calc_submit payload shape in the doc: ```{ "variant": "above_fold", "value": "$X", "tier": "Scale" }```
kevin: Figma links: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/pricing-calc-test (mock frames: A,B,C).
maria: Timeline: mock + copy by EOD today, kevin hands to eng for A/B routing tomorrow, QA Thu, launch Fri (so we have 3 days pre-webinar signal). Is that tight?
on launch-bot: experiment-scheduler created experiment "pricing-inline-calc-4400123456" start=4400124000 end=4400200000 cohorts=2
jon: I'll draft the announcement post for the webinar comms channel and the support snippet for CS. Emma, can you draft the social post that mentions the "try the estimator" nudge?
emma: Yep — short social copy and a 1-pager for sales with the expected uplift ranges.
maria: Good. One last ask: keep FAQ updates minimal — only add one new FAQ about "how estimates are calculated" to avoid SEO churn. Kevin, add an anchor id so we can deep-link from emails.
kevin: Will do. I'll also add a small toggled header: "Try the estimator" so it's visible when collapsed.
sarah: I'll add the routing rule and test on staging after deploy. Tagging @jon to confirm experiment audience filters (only non-paid users for the test).
jon: Confirmed: exclude existing paying accounts and org admins. Also exclude internal traffic.
maria: Great — thanks everyone. Quick sync 1pm if we need to iron anything out. :thumbsup:
